critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1302 lines and still growing (adds nudge-goals + tasks CRUD + invite_expires_at); split into routers (auth, advisor, planning, tasks) is overdue — raised in iter14/15/16, still unaddressed.

MyPlan.jsx: uses user.name.split(' ')[0] without null guard beyond `(user.name || '')` — fine, but when user is briefly null during hydration the useAuth hook returns null and page would crash; wrap in `if (!user) return null;` or Loading.

TaskBoard.jsx: tasks query key is ['tasks'] and clientsQ ['clients'] — same key as AdvisorClients (good for cache reuse) but if advisor opens /tasks without visiting /clients first, nameFor(cid) falls back to raw client_id — minor UX, acceptable.
AdvisorClients invite-expiry inline IIFE recomputes Math.ceil on every render but uses Date.now() — fine, no bug; consider extracting into a tiny useMemo for readability.

nudge_goals endpoint: _required_monthly uses months to end-of-target-year without month precision (uses years*12 from current year); for a goal with target_year == current year, months=1 which can yield unrealistically large monthly req; works but edge case worth noting.
nudge_goals audit message writes 'goals' as entity but doesn't include client_id as a structured field — only in details string; acceptable.
TaskBoard complete mutation has no success toast (only onError) — minor UX inconsistency vs clear mutation which does show 'Task cleared'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (nudge-goals, tasks CRUD, invite expiry — all verified)
